text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, extending a four-day rally that's recovered most of last week's losses. The bounce aligns with a modest recovery in crude prices—U.S. oil climbed back above $89 a barrel—and reflects investor rotation back into energy stocks after weakness earlier in the month. The stock has now gained about $6 in four days, suggesting some bargain-hunting after the 7.6% decline from early November.

The broader backdrop remains mixed for oil refiners and producers. While heating oil prices have spiked 59% from last winter (signaling strong winter demand ahead), the IEA's report that Russian crude production has rebounded and global supply has swung back into surplus pressures the upside on prices. That supply surplus is the real constraint on how far crude—and stocks like this one—can run from here.
